entries.description: IHANO lya MAHANGA LYA HAKI YA BANHU
entries.subject: IHANO

spans.text: IHANO LYA MAHANGA LYA HAKI YA BANHU
Kila munhu ng’w’Ihano lya Nsi wina haki ya kupiw’ikujo
Banhu bose ng’w’Ihano lya Nsi bina haki ja kulabandwa bila kubagulwa.

entries.description: nsi Ilagilo lya Nsi lilabade haki jabo
entries.subject: nsi Ilagilo

spans.text: NGUNO giki ulu abanhu bakasaziwagwa kuhaya basole mashilanga kuzitula bushimba, kulema kwibonelwa na bahanya ba nsi Ilagilo lya Nsi lilabade haki jabo,
Kila munhu wina haki ya kulabandwa na Ilagilo lya Nsi.

spans.text: Hangi giki, kukize kubi busolaniwa ku nzila ja butemi wa nsi yi bi yitabalile ninga yitabalilwe.
Kila munhu ali na haki ya kulipwa n’ibanza la nsi yakwe ulu witilwa mashito ga kung’wigij’ ikujo na haki ijo jandikwa na Ihano lya Nsi yakwe.

entries.subject: ayo gakahayilwe
entries.object: buhubi u mu luganda lwa nsi nulu mahanga aho alihubila nulu kukenagula

spans.text: Nduhu munhu ubaziwagwa wahuba kufuma nisho washidakilwa nulu kwita mashito ayo gakahayilwe kubi buhubi u mu luganda lwa nsi nulu mahanga aho alihubila nulu kukenagula.
Kila munhu wina haki ya kubi na nsi.
Kila munhu wina haki ya kubi mu selekali ya nsi yakwe weyi msaba nulu kubitila ku bangi.
